title: Kronecker property dx^I(e_J) = δ_IJ for strictly increasing I, J
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let I, J : Fin n → Fin P be strictly increasing, and let θ be an n-covector on ℝ^P (θ ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n) with θ(v) = det(Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k)) for every v : Fin n → ℝ^P. Let e_i := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i be the standard basis vectors of ℝ^P. Then θ(fun j => e_{J j}) = 1 if I = J, and θ(fun j => e_{J j}) = 0 if I ≠ J.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (I J : Fin n → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) n), StrictMono I → StrictMono J → (∀ v : Fin n → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → θ (fun j => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (J j)) = if I = J then 1 else 0
